name: Sheriela Haiwan
original_name: シェリエラ・ハイワン
source:
The guild receptionist who deals with all new slaves upon their arrival and their subsequent forays into the Black Pit. She has a photographic memory and is capable of remembering the name of each and every slave warrior in Grasesta after meeting them the first time. 

Part of her duties require her to act as a liaison between adventurers and the guild administration. In addition, any new discoveries or achievements require her to act as a witness for official verification purposes.

Her friendly demeanour and striking looks earn her the admiration of all slave warriors she deals with. She has a particular liking for strong men.

[Spoiler] Sheriela had been turned into a Rinshi by Legi long before Judar's arrival in Grasesta. She believes in Legi's cause but only makes a move when Judar and his party get too close to the truth behind the Rinshi laboratory. It is Sheriela who transforms Commander Adler and his second in command into Rinshi when Dulphia is away with Judar, precipitating the Blue Hawk rebellion as transformed members attempt to convert the rest of the Grasesta into Rinshi.

When Sheriela transforms at the top of the tower but is defeated by Judar and his party, her disintegrating body is absorbed by Legi allowing him to acquire a resistance to the Rinshi's fatal weakness against the moon goddess's powers. When Legi is finally defeated, her soul is also set free along with the others trapped in Legi's god form. [/Spoiler]
